The output grid size...is the shape of the multi-colored rectangle

To make the output, you have to...Insert the cyan shape into the multi-colored rectangle. For each part of the cyan shape that touches exactly one of the original colored lines that make up the rectangle, the cells are recolored from cyan to the touching color. If multiple of the original colored cells of the rectangle touch a cyan cell, or the cyan cell does not originally touch parts of the colored rectangle (only after initial recoloring), they stay cyan. The output is just the rectangle cut out with the cyan inside it.
